title: docs: move GPU fleet inventory under operations
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves the live Vast GPU fleet inventory to operations/infrastructure/gpu.
- Updates GPU management, monitoring, token-rotation, and SANA runbook references.
- Starts the staged removal of the image.pollinations.ai root without moving model runtimes yet.
- Does not change production routing, deployment workflows, credentials, or running GPU instances.

Validation:
- git diff --check
- repository-wide stale-path scan
- relative link and file existence checks

Follow-ups will move active model backends one workload at a time before legacy assets are reviewed and the old root is removed.

gist.headline: The GPU map moved house
gist.blurb: The live GPU fleet inventory has been replanted under operations, with its runbooks following the trail. No servers moved; the labels on the garden shed just got less mysterious.
gist.summary: Moved the live Vast GPU fleet inventory to operations/infrastructure/gpu and updated GPU management, monitoring, token-rotation, and SANA runbook references as the first step toward retiring the image.pollinations.ai root.
gist.impact: Operators now have GPU fleet documentation and related runbooks organized under operations/infrastructure/gpu, while production routing, deployments, credentials, and running instances remain unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy infrastructure garden where a clearly labeled GPU inventory folder is carried from an old image.pollinations.ai shed to a neat operations/infrastructure/gpu filing cabinet. Polli, wearing a tiny operations hard hat, guides the move while code-plants and small server racks make the internal reorganization feel warm rather than dramatic.
